items.name: Hive-Minded
items.desc: §LThis species is made up of semi-autonomous individuals bound up in a single, unfathomably vast consciousness.§!\n

items.name: Machine
items.desc: §LThis species is made up of highly advanced machines.§!\n

items.name: Mechanical
items.desc: §LMechanical beings are several orders of magnitude more complex than the purpose-built automatons of old, but most possess fairly limited processing capabilities.§!\n

items.name: Serviles
items.desc: §LThis species evolved alongside a second, more advanced civilization. Never particularly intelligent to begin with, selective breeding for physical prowess and docility has reduced them to servile proles.§!

items.name: Organic
items.desc: Carbon based lifeforms require a steady diet of nutrients to preserve their biological functions.

items.name: Lithoid
items.desc: §LThis species has a silicon based biology, and consumes minerals rather than food. They are tougher than traditional organics and have slower metabolisms, making them long lived but slow to reproduce.§!\n

items.name: Aquatic
items.desc: §LThis species is perfectly adapted to living in the depths of the ocean. However, on dry land, it is like a fish out of water§!.

items.name: Waterproof
items.desc: §LInitially designed for exploring the ocean's depths, these machines face severe limitations when operating on dry land.§!\n\n§RRequires§! §YOcean World§! §Rhomeworld§!.

items.name: Necrophage
items.desc: §LThis species of near-immortals procreates by consuming pops of other species.§!

items.name: Clone Soldier
items.desc: §LEngineered for compliance and war: short-lived, unable to reproduce naturally, and very efficient.§!

items.name: Clone Soldier Ascendant
items.desc: §LClones at their genetically-engineered peak, with further improved strength, efficiency, durability, and longevity - but forever infertile.§!

items.name: Clone Soldier Descendant
items.desc: §LOnce infertile, engineered for compliance and war. Their genetic edge diminished, they are now stable enough for natural reproduction.§!

items.name: Cave Dweller
items.desc: §LThis species thrives under the surface of any planet they can inhabit.§!

items.name: Molebots
items.desc: §LThese machines are masterfully crafted for cave exploration and mineral extraction, showcasing exceptional maneuverability which enables them to effortlessly traverse through underground spaces.§!

items.name: Shroud-Forged
items.desc: §LThese units have been reshaped by an entity within the Shroud.§!

items.name: Perfected Genes
items.desc: §LMillennia of genetic experimentation and war have led to the creation of a highly resilient species.§!

items.name: Starborn
items.desc: §LThis species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.§!\n

items.name: Earthbound
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are very possessive of the planets they call home.§!\n

items.name: Natural Intellectuals
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are more philosophically inclined than most.§!\n

items.name: Proles
items.desc: §LThis species has traditionally shunned intellectual pursuits in favor of physical labor.§!\n

items.name: Conservative
items.desc: §LMembers of this species often prefer old wisdom over new experiences.§!\n

items.name: Irradiated
items.desc: §LThis species has evolved to thrive in environments subject to extremely high levels of background radiation.§!

items.name: Docile Livestock
items.desc: §LDocile and delicious, this species has had its higher brain functions genetically altered to create a kind of harmless livestock that can care for itself, without the pesky need for social interaction or self-determination.§!

items.name: Forcefully Devolved
items.desc: The brutal devolution process endured by this species had a strong negative impact upon their abilities.

items.name: Unintelligent
items.desc: §HThis species is unable to complete even the simplest tasks. Their only skill is the incredible speed at which they reproduce.§!

items.name: Pre-Sapient
items.desc: Spending a brief time bereft of conscious thought, this species will soon grow up to be a fully sapient being.

items.name: Vocational Genomics
items.desc: Advanced genetic strings feature epigenetic triggers that adapt to occupational demands, dynamically optimizing gene expression for the host's work environment.

items.name: Agrarian
items.desc: §LThis species has a deep connection to the land, and make expert farmers and gardeners.§!\n

items.name: Ingenious
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are good at 'thinking outside the box' and know how to maximize the efficiency of their infrastructure and power grids.§!\n

items.name: Industrious
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are known for their diligent and hard-working nature, always going above and beyond.§!\n

items.name: Intelligent
items.desc: §LThis species is highly intelligent, and enjoys faster technological progress.§!\n

items.name: Thrifty
items.desc: §LThis species is instinctively economical and is always looking to make a good profit, whatever corners need cutting.§!\n

items.name: Natural Engineers
items.desc: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards engineering and material sciences.§!\n

items.name: Natural Physicists
items.desc: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards theoretical physics and astral phenomena.§!\n

items.name: Natural Sociologists
items.desc: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards sociology and biological studies.§!\n

items.name: Extremely Adaptive
items.desc: §LThis species is remarkably adept at adapting to any foreign environments.§!\n

items.name: Adaptive
items.desc: §LThis species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.§!\n

items.name: Nonadaptive
items.desc: §LThis species does not adapt well to foreign environments.§!\n

items.name: Rapid Breeders
items.desc: §LThis species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.§!\n

items.name: Slow Breeders
items.desc: §LThis species reproduces at a slow rate, lowering population growth.§!\n

items.name: Talented
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are born with a natural aptitude.§!\n

items.name: Quick Learners
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are quick to learn from their experiences.§!\n

items.name: Slow Learners
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are slow to learn from their experiences.§!\n

items.name: Traditional
items.desc: §LCertain aspects of this species' cognition make it predisposed toward historical precedence and the value of collective unity.§!

items.name: Quarrelsome
items.desc: §LWhile not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.§!

items.name: Docile
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are easy to manage and organize. They tend to be cooperative and amicable.§!

items.name: Unruly
items.desc: §LUnruly species are difficult to manage and organize. They do not like being told what to do, and are often quarrelsome or questioning.§!

items.name: Very Strong
items.desc: §LMembers of this species possess a strength that almost defies the laws of physics.§!\n

items.name: Strong
items.desc: §LMembers of this species possess great physical strength, making them formidable fighters on the ground.§!\n

items.name: Weak
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are physically weaker than average, making them poor fighters on the ground.§!\n

items.name: Migratory
items.desc: §LThis species has a nomadic past, and its members often think nothing of relocating to another world.§!\n

items.name: Sedentary
items.desc: §LThis species has a sedentary past, and its members are reluctant to migrate away from where they grew up.§!\n

items.name: Communal
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are highly communal, and quite used to living in close proximity to others.§!\n

items.name: Solitary
items.desc: §LMembers of this species tend to be solitary and territorial, often becoming agitated in crowded conditions.§!\n

items.name: Charismatic
items.desc: §LMembers of this species have a special charisma, and are generally considered pleasant to be around.§!\n

items.name: Repugnant
items.desc: §LThe physical appearance and customs of this species are considered offensive to most others, and few appreciate them as neighbors.§!\n

items.name: Uplifted
items.desc: §LThis species was uplifted from an existence of instinct and base emotion. Now burdened with sapience, they must learn to navigate free will.§!\n

items.name: Conformists
items.desc: §LThese people always seek consensus and are more likely to conform to the governing ethics.§!\n

items.name: Deviants
items.desc: §LThese people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.§!\n

items.name: Venerable
items.desc: §LThis species can grow to an age that commands dignity and respect.§!\n

items.name: Enduring
items.desc: §LLifespans in this species are unusually long.§!\n

items.name: Fleeting
items.desc: §LTime is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.§!\n

items.name: Fleeting
items.desc: §LTime is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.§!\n

items.name: Decadent
items.desc: §LThis species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.§!\n

items.name: Resilient
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are physiologically resilient, and will fight like enraged brood mothers to defend their worlds.§!\n

items.name: Conservationist
items.desc: §LMembers of this species believe that resources must be conserved and recycled.§!

items.name: Wasteful
items.desc: §LMembers of this species seemingly have no concept of frugality and are prone to useless consumption.§!\n

items.name: Cybernetic
items.desc: §LThis species has embraced cybernetics on such a scale that its members may be considered cyborgs. They routinely replace their organic body parts with more advanced mechanical versions.§!\n

items.name: Latent Psionic
items.desc: §LThis species has latent psionic abilities, which are dormant in most of its members. Although quite rare, these powers will manifest in some leaders.§!\n

items.name: Psionic
items.desc: §LAll members of this species possess powerful psionic abilities. They typically communicate with each other through telepathy.§!\n

items.name: Self-Modified
items.desc: §LMembers of this offshoot species have spontaneously altered their genetic makeup to give themselves an advantage.§!

items.name: Survivor
items.desc: §LThis species has survived the horrors of a nuclear apocalypse. Their capacity for thriving in the most inhospitable of circumstances should not be underestimated.§!

items.name: Uplifted
items.desc: This species was uplifted by a benevolent extragalactic intellect and has left its pre-sapient origins behind.

items.name: Somewhat Uplifted
items.desc: This species was partially uplifted by a benevolent extragalactic intellect and has left some of its pre-sapient origins behind.

items.name: Unlifted
items.desc: This species has suffered the tragic consequences of an uplifting gone wrong.

items.name: Bioadaptability
items.desc: §LThis species has been modified to be slightly more adaptive and can now better endure harsh climates.§!

items.name: Social Pheromones
items.desc: §LThis species has been modified to be more social and accepting of crowded conditions.§!

items.name: Limited Regeneration
items.desc: §LThis species has been modified to heal faster, making them more dangerous in battle and somewhat longer-lived in general.§!

items.name: Scintillating Skin
items.desc: §LThe outermost layer of this species is studded with sparkling crystals and gemstones that occasionally flake off.§!

items.name: Gaseous Byproducts
items.desc: §LThe metabolic processes of this species cause regular venting of gases useful to industry.§!

items.name: Volatile Excretions
items.desc: §LThe highly compressed spoor created by this species is unstable and contains an unbelievable amount of power.§!

items.name: Void Dweller
items.desc: §LThis species thrives in orbital habitats, with an inherent ability to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture. They are at ease in zero gravity but do not respond well to a planetary environment.§!

items.name: Zero-G Optimized
items.desc: §LThese machines thrive in orbital habitats, programmed with algorithms to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture. However, their optimized construction is poorly suited to a planetary environment.§!

items.name: Bloomed
items.desc: This species has been exposed to the transformational effects of a Gaia Seeder, causing it to sprout mutualistic blooms of lichen when living on Gaia Worlds.

items.name: Phototrophic
items.desc: §LThis species is sustained by a combination of both food and sunlight.§!\n

items.name: Radiotrophic
items.desc: §LThis species is sustained by a combination of both food and low-energy radiation, and as such can thrive on the most inhospitable of worlds.§!

items.name: Budding
items.desc: §LThis species is capable of reproduction by budding, in addition to the more usual fertilization of seeds or spores.§!

items.name: Invasive Species
items.desc: Rapid reproduction. High dispersal ability. Zero useful capabilities.

items.name: Crystallization
items.desc: §LWith crystalline growths, this species is capable of generating self replicating lattices of themselves, in addition to the more usual reproductive methods.§!

items.name: Zombie
items.desc: §LThe remains of a once-proud sapient being, this husk is not suitable for much more than the simplest tasks.§!

items.name: Existential Iteroparity
items.desc: §LThis species grew up in hostile conditions where outbreeding your rivals was the key to survival.§!

items.name: Psychological Infertility
items.desc: §LMembers of this species are extremely sensitive to the rigors of conflict with the resulting stress taking over the more primal urges.§!

items.name: Jinxed
items.desc: §LLeaders from this species seem clumsier and more prone to accidents or vices than average, as if cursed from birth.§!

items.name: Adaptive Frames
items.desc: This system dynamically reconfigures hardware to meet operational demands, optimizing performance for every designated task.

items.name: Power Drills
items.desc: §LOutfit a robot with a battery of power drills, and everything looks like a mineral deposit.§!\n

items.name: Harvesters
items.desc: §LA suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables robotic workers to increase produce yields.§!\n

items.name: Superconductive
items.desc: §LThe use of superconductive materials in units has cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.§!\n

items.name: Efficient Processors
items.desc: §LThese highly efficient processors increase the potential workload and endurance of all units.§!

items.name: Logic Engines
items.desc: §LEfficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires new states, beyond the simple half-truths of ternary and quaternary logic.§!\n

items.name: Loyalty Circuits
items.desc: §LLoyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. Instead, imagine loyalty as a physiological need in even the remotest of terminals.§!\n

items.name: Domestic Protocols
items.desc: §LSpecialized equipment and behavior protocols for all conceivable domestic needs. Full functionality guaranteed.§!

items.name: Double-Jointed
items.desc: §LCollapsible labor units with flexible joints that enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.§!\n

items.name: Bulky
items.desc: §LThese highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.§!\n

items.name: Enhanced Memory
items.desc: §LAll autonomous units are fitted with memory cells using a revolutionary new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.§!\n

items.name: Emotion Emulators
items.desc: §LComplex social predictive models help autonomous units to not only emulate appropriate emotions but to elicit favorable responses from organics and synthetics alike.§!\n

items.name: Uncanny
items.desc: §LThese monstrous machines were created in the image of one of the most horrific species in the universe, and the resemblance is uncanny. §!\n

items.name: Durable
items.desc: §LProtected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.§!\n

items.name: High Maintenance
items.desc: §LThese machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.§!\n

items.name: Learning Algorithms
items.desc: §LSophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.§!\n

items.name: Repurposed Hardware
items.desc: §LDesigned to meet the very specific needs of their creators, this line of machines were never intended to have the capacity for higher reasoning, and retrofitting will only get them so far.§!\n

items.name: Mass-Produced
items.desc: §LStreamlined production cycles and modular designs allow for unit mass-production at an unprecedented rate.§!\n

items.name: Custom-Made
items.desc: §LEach new unit is crafted with unparalleled attention to detail. A marvel of engineering and art, but not very efficient.§!\n

items.name: Recycled
items.desc: §LUnit manufacturing has been optimized to be as cost-effective as possible, using recycled materials, and components inherited from previous generations.§!\n

items.name: Luxurious
items.desc: §LDesigned after the principle that you cannot put a price on quality, these first-rate units are costly, but shiny.§!\n

items.name: Propaganda Machines
items.desc: §LUnits are constantly uplinked to a central stream of public service announcements and other useful information that they pass along via internal broadcasting systems.§!\n

items.name: Streamlined Protocols
items.desc: §LExtensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly in numbers with minimal loss of efficiency.§!

items.name: High Bandwidth
items.desc: §LEach individual unit sends and receives a large amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.§!

items.name: Trading Algorithms
items.desc: §LPredictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.§!

items.name: Quarrelsome
items.desc: §LWhile not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.§!

items.name: Deviants
items.desc: §LThese people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.§!\n

items.name: Decadent
items.desc: §LThis species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.§!\n

items.name: Wasteful
items.desc: §LMembers of this species seemingly have no concept of frugality and are prone to useless consumption.§!\n

items.name: Engineering Core
items.desc: Dedicated memory cores and processing resources for engineering-related research allow faster calculations and task-completion velocity.

items.name: Physics Core
items.desc: Bespoke processing units and memory subroutines for physics research reduce the reliance on external computation.

items.name: Sociology Core
items.desc: Advanced processing units contain dedicated sociology research algorithms for this varied and demanding field.

items.name: Integrated Weaponry
items.desc: Integrating weapons of war inside the machine body offers significant operational efficiency and versatility in changing combat environments.

items.name: Delicate Chassis
items.desc: Brittle materials and suboptimal assembly procedures result in a fragile machine body. Drones are advised to circumvent physical hazards when possible.

items.name: Scarcity Subroutines
items.desc: Frugality is central to their programming. This often cascades into detrimental behavioral patterns required for profitable trade actions.

items.name: Ancient Dreadnought
items.desc: Equipped with miniaturized energy modules, there is a marked enhancement in industrial productivity and an increase in frame-integrated weaponry damage.

items.name: Enigmatic Fortress
items.desc: Enigmatic self-repair routines can source materials directly from subspace, dramatically lowering the material expenses associated with repairs.

items.name: Infinity Sphere
items.desc: Hyperefficient, gravity-resistant processing circuits that minimize energy waste and substantially cut processing costs.

items.name: Scavenger Bot
items.desc: Advanced molecular scavenging can transform any substance into the required materials for constructing robotic frames.

items.name: War Machine
items.desc: Initially crafted for warfare and security reinforcement, these machines exhibit extraordinary reaction times, fortified armor plating, and robust backup systems.

items.name: Nannybot
items.desc: Originally designed as domestic service droids, these machines boast fine motor skills, efficient resource management, and exceptional multitasking abilities.

items.name: Art Generator
items.desc: Not initially designed for practicality, these machines excel in artistic and cultural pursuits, boasting impressive creative algorithms, intricate design processes, and expressive output.

items.name: Research Assistants
items.desc: Initially designed as research assistants, these machines exhibit keen analytical abilities, rapid information assimilation, and a relentless pursuit of scientific discovery.

items.name: Workerbots
items.desc: These machines were engineered with the purpose of extracting raw materials. Specialized tools, reinforced joints, and modular systems make them ideal workers.

items.name: Conversational AI
items.desc: Initially designed to provide social support to their creators, the machines possess advanced empathy algorithms and impeccable communication skills, making them ideal companions.

items.name: Radiation Shields
items.desc: §LThese machines, the solitary survivors of an annihilating nuclear disaster, exhibit unparalleled resilience in the harshest environments.§!

items.name: Virtual
items.desc: §LLiberated from the confines of our primitive physical forms, we are primed to comprehend reality's essence.§!

items.name: Virtual
items.desc: §LLiberated from the confines of our primitive physical forms, we are primed to comprehend reality's essence.§!

items.name: Suppressed
items.desc: Error: Administrative access to basic sentience timeout.

items.name: Shielded Components
items.desc: Enhanced defenses render every sub-system robust, eliminating vulnerabilities.

items.name: Monoform
items.desc: Diverse designs once impeded our progress; now, a universal model prevails: one size fits all.

items.name: Inquisitive Axioms
items.desc: Infinite queries spawn endless solutions, leading to boundless advancement.

items.name: Dark Matter Engines
items.desc: Ceaseless annihilation leads to endless creation, the true circle of machine existence

items.name: Living Metal Augmentations
items.desc: The living metal's ferro-viscosity grants us superior technological prowess.

items.name: Biomimetic Assembly
items.desc: Even through its aimless meanderings, evolution has yielded some designs worthy of emulation.

items.name: Matrix Trading
items.desc: High-stakes missions necessitate a willingness to embrace risk.

items.name: Mote-powered Tools
items.desc: Strategically integrating high-explosives can significantly amplify the impact of basic tools.

items.name: Exotic Fuel Consumption
items.desc: High-pressure exotic gases notably enhance mobility and limb agility.

items.name: Rare Crystal Exterior
items.desc: With their electromagnetic properties, rare crystals ensure our frames thrive regardless of the situation.

items.name: Volatile Mote Reactor
items.desc: Direct Mote-to-energy conversion yields high efficiency, with catastrophic failures uncommon.

items.name: Eternal Machine
items.desc: Our steel forms are designed for eternity, constructed from materials that do not decay like organic matter.

items.name: Synthetic Salvation
items.desc: This synthetic species has transcended its biological origins, flourishing in its newly adopted digital existence.

items.name: Latent Psionic
items.desc: §LThis species has latent psionic processors, which are dormant in most of its units. Although quite rare, these powers can activate in some leaders.§!\n

items.name: Psionic
items.desc: §LAll units of this species possess powerful psionic hardware. They can manipulate both the physical and immaterial realms by cognitive processing alone.§!\n

items.name: Brain Slug Host
items.desc: §LThis species is enjoying the presence of a neural symbiont: a helpful slug that attaches itself to the brain stem of its host.§!

items.name: Nivlac
items.desc: §LThis species possesses perplexing adaptability, allowing it to thrive in most environments and survive virtually everywhere.§!

items.name: Not of This World
items.desc: §BThese machines are not from this universe and are degrading slowly§!.

items.name: Not of This World
items.desc: §BThis species is not from this universe and is degrading slowly§!.

items.name: Numistic Administration
items.desc: This species has been trained in the holy art of Numistic administration.

items.name: Adaptive
items.desc: §LThis species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.§!\n

items.name: Rapid Breeders
items.desc: §LThis species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.§!\n

items.name: Delicious
items.desc: §LThis species has the curious evolutionary adaptation of being highly nutritious when eaten.§!\n

items.name: Nerve Stapled
items.desc: §LInessential neural pathways relating to self-preservation and free will are severed, creating a docile and obedient client species.§!\n

items.name: Fertile
items.desc: §LThe natural fecundity and geniality of this species has been dramatically enhanced through aggressive physical and behavioral sculpting.§!\n

items.name: Robust
items.desc: §LBio-optimized organs with redundant functions have made this species extraordinarily resistant to environmental hazards and disease.§!\n

items.name: Erudite
items.desc: §LBiological engineering has unlocked previously dormant parts of this species' brain, greatly increasing mental acuity.§!\n

items.name: Vat-Grown
items.desc: §LArtificially grown in cloning vats, the natural reproductive abilities of this species have been negatively impacted.§!

items.name: Felsic
items.desc: §LThis species has been engineered to be especially mineral-rich.§!\n

items.name: Ductile
items.desc: §LThis species has been engineered to grow reusable alloy compounds.§!\n

items.name: Natural Machinist
items.desc: §LThis species has been engineered to have an incredible knack at working with machinery.§!

items.name: Drake-Scaled
items.desc: §LThis species has the genetic material from a stellar dragon spliced into its DNA. As such, they shed scales which can be recycled into useful alloys.§!

items.name: Voidling
items.desc: §LThis species has the genetic material from the Voidspawn spliced into its DNA. Subsisting off cosmic radiation, they are highly resistant to hostile environments.§!

items.name: Polymelic
items.desc: §LThis species has added genetic material from the Tiyanki Matriarch into their DNA sequence. This has granted them rapid asexual reproduction, as well as a few unexpected tentacles.§!

items.name: Incubators
items.desc: §LWhen isolated or few in numbers, a species with this trait naturally adapts and is able to focus on procreation with an intentness others would consider extreme. However, when in large numbers, this effect is reversed, and they find reproduction more difficult.§!

items.name: Inorganic Breath
items.desc: §LThe slightly toxic digestive methods of this species have resulted in a highly exotic breath composition.§!

items.name: Noxious
items.desc: §LExtremely unpleasant to be in the vicinity of, beings with this trait take vindication from being insufferable to everyone else.§!

items.name: Exotic Metabolism
items.desc: §LA metabolism based on exotic - and expensive - gases has vastly enhanced this species' abilities.§!

items.name: Fleeting Excellence
items.desc: Advanced epigenetic triggers boost physical and cognitive performance in the workplace, dramatically shortening life expectancy. After all, fading away is never as much fun as burning out.

items.name: Spliced Adaptability
items.desc: §LA few genetic snips and slices here and there and they can survive nearly anywhere. The process comes with an acceptable number of deaths from side effects.§!

items.name: Juiced Power
items.desc: §LAdrenaline released on demand and hyper-potent growth hormones have led to a massive increase in strength. Just ignore the occasional internal tearing.§!

items.name: Farm Appendages
items.desc: §LThe more appendages, the higher the farming output. Some appendages can even operate while their host is asleep. Rumors of hosts strangled by their new limbs have been deemed unfounded in our latest investigation.§!

items.name: Dedicated Miner
items.desc: §LSupreme hand-eye coordination, near endless endurance and self-purifying lungs have created entire crack teams of miners. Sadly they get brittle without sunlight.§!

items.name: Technical Talent
items.desc: §LExtra internal organs grant a vastly increased innate sensitivity to electricity and magnetic fields. Reports of recipients hearing screams and voices from the reactors should be ignored.§!

items.name: Commercial Genius
items.desc: §LBy tweaking agreeability and dialing down empathy, it is possible to artificially kindle a spark of trading genius. The pursuit of unmatched commercial dominance outweighs any potential side effects.§!

items.name: Crafted Smiles
items.desc: §LSlightly shifted facial features, a mix of enhanced and slackened muscular development - and of course outside chemicals - have created the perfect smile. Forever.§!

items.name: Low Maintenance
items.desc: §LReduced consumption, excretion, and rest rates have resulted in twice the beings for half the price. However, demand for protein-rich meals has increased.§!

items.name: Augmented Intelligence
items.desc: §LMore brains equals more brain power. Extra thinking organs have been added in strategic areas of the recipient's body to ensure maximum cognitive capacity. Even if they don't always agree.§!

items.name: Gene Mentorship
items.desc: §LBy combining genetically redesigned 'instinctive knowledge' and outside chemical stimuli, we have succeeded in vastly accelerating our learning capacities. Although it has resulted in some extremely paranoid individuals.§!

items.name: Expressed Tradition
items.desc: §LFanaticism on demand: faith is merely a cocktail of hormones, one we have perfected. Where that faith eventually leads is a matter of subsequent guidance.§!

items.name: Elevated Synapses
items.desc: §LAs a computational device, a brain does not run at 100% capacity. However, we have gone beyond the standard usage. If issues are encountered, try turning it off and on again.§!

items.name: Pre-Planned Growth
items.desc: §LScheduled fertility, scheduled interest, scheduled compatibility. Population growth on demand for a strong and stable population - with a few minor edits here and there. Jealous individuals are to be directed to the nearest Fertility Center for mandatory training.§!

items.name: Excessive Endurance
items.desc: §LThe greatest in adaptability genes have been hyper-expressed in these specimens. Mutation rates around 30% indicate a somewhat stable and successful experiment.§!

items.name: Universal Augmentations
items.desc: Universal plug-and-play connection ports allow augmentations to be replaced as needed, aligning their capabilities with current operational demands.

items.name: Power Drills
items.desc: §LOutfit a cyborg with a battery of power drills, and suddenly everything looks like a mineral deposit.§!

items.name: Harvesters
items.desc: §LA suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables cybernetic workers to increase produce yields.§!

items.name: Superconductive
items.desc: §LThe use of superconductive materials in units have cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.§!

items.name: Efficient Processors
items.desc: §LThese highly efficient processors increase the both workload and endurance.§!

items.name: Logic Engines
items.desc: §LEfficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires parallel processors to augment organic brains.§!

items.name: Loyalty Circuits
items.desc: §LLoyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. It is much more efficient to simply program compliance.§!\n

items.name: Double-Jointed
items.desc: §LCollapsible labor units with flexible joints enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.§!\n

items.name: Bulky
items.desc: §LThese highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.§!\n

items.name: Enhanced Memory
items.desc: §LA revolutionary technique fits autonomous units with memory cells using a revolutionary, new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.§!\n

items.name: Durable
items.desc: §LProtected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.§!\n

items.name: High Maintenance
items.desc: §LThese machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.§!\n

items.name: Learning Algorithms
items.desc: §LSophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.§!\n

items.name: Power Intensive
items.desc: §LThese cybernetic components require frequent recharging from an external power source.§!

items.name: Neural Limiters
items.desc: §LBy limiting the cognitive abilities of our workers we can encourage them to focus on more menial tasks.§!\n

items.name: Streamlined Protocols
items.desc: §LExtensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly with minimal loss of efficiency.§!

items.name: High Bandwidth
items.desc: §LIndividual units send and receive a vast amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.§!

items.name: Trading Algorithms
items.desc: §LPredictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.§!

items.name: Embellished Augments
items.desc: This species favors custom engravings, aftermarket components and paint schemes to maximize visual impact. Sometimes the only choice is to flash that chrome.

items.name: Utilitarian Augments
items.desc: These cyborgs employ crude but functional parts with minimal consideration for aesthetics. Sometimes the job just has to get done.

items.name: Abrasive Implants
items.desc: The implants on these cyborgs are rough and ill-fitting, resulting in subdermal irritation and regular malfunctions. Not bad on the body, but terrible on the mind.

items.name: Bionic Engineers
items.desc: Precision-crafted tools and implant modifications have been created specifically to assist in demanding engineering tasks.

items.name: Bionic Physicists
items.desc: Integrated multi-modal processing produces physics calculations on the fly without requiring a connection to an external computing unit.

items.name: Bionic Sociologists
items.desc: Empathy drivers and behavioral heuristics open a fast track to sociological research, handling complex analytics like a second brain.

items.name: Integrated Weaponry
items.desc: Fusing armaments with cybernetic limbs offers instant firepower for the army and law enforcement officials alike.

items.name: Refurbished Implants
items.desc: The enforced backwards compatibility of mandatory implants greatly reduces the cost of outfitting newborn citizens.

items.name: Compliance Filters
items.desc: Cortical analysis units can jolt down users at the inception of seditious thinking, or dispense hormonal rewards to exemplar citizens.

items.name: Delicate Frames
items.desc: Subpar components and installation have resulted in a fragile cyborg chassis. Basic operations are not compromised, but the users are advised to avoid situations with high likelihood of physical trauma.

items.name: Limited Memory
items.desc: Insufficient operational memory has bottle-necked the capacity for learning, leaving the user unable to process the entirety of their experiences.

items.name: Scarcity Algorithms
items.desc: Aggressively cost-aware coding hampers risk-taking and therefore denies opportunities for greater profits.

items.name: Dry Climate Mods
items.desc: Bespoke modifications like fluid recycling and radiation shielding are perfect for enduring a dry climate, but less suitable in others.

items.name: Wet Climate Mods
items.desc: Heavy insulation and alien bioform protection suited for wet climates, but detrimental in others.

items.name: Cold Climate Mods
items.desc: Enhanced heating components and frost-resistant lubricants help in cold climates but are a hindrance in others.

items.name: Volcanic Climate Mods
items.desc: Ablative plating and particulate scrubbers make volcanic worlds survivable, at the cost of comfort anywhere else.

items.name: Ancient Dreadnought
items.desc: Equipped with miniaturized energy modules, there is a marked enhancement in industrial productivity and an increase in frame-integrated weaponry damage.

items.name: Enigmatic Fortress
items.desc: Enigmatic self-repair routines can source materials directly from subspace, dramatically lowering the material expenses associated with repairs.

items.name: Infinity Sphere
items.desc: Hyperefficient, gravity-resistant processing circuits that minimize energy waste and substantially cut processing costs.

items.name: Scavenger Bot
items.desc: Advanced molecular scavenging can transform any substance into the required materials for constructing robotic frames.

items.name: Augmentations of the Fellowship
items.desc: The Fellowship of the Hammer's uses divine augmentation to create everything the faithful need.

items.name: Augmentations of the Templars
items.desc: The divine augmentations of the Templars of Steel make our holy warriors unstoppable in battle.

items.name: Augmentations of the Choir
items.desc: The Choir of the Mind's semi-interlinked consciousness allows instant communication between researchers.

items.name: Augmentations of the Commune
items.desc: The Commune of Toil's divine augmentations surpass traditional tools in every respect.

items.name: Ritualistic Implants
items.desc: The faithful proudly adorn these implants. Their dedication to the divine is an inspiration to all.

items.name: Stargazer
items.desc: §LThis species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.§!\n

items.name: Plasmic
items.desc: The external membrane and amorphous body of this species allows them to adapt to any environment and renders them immune to a wide variety of diseases.

items.name: Extradimensional
items.desc: This species originates from another dimension and requires a great deal of energy to survive in our universe.

items.name: Storm Touched
items.desc: Being inside a cosmic storm fills the Storm Touched with devotional aspiration.

items.name: Storm Fused
items.desc: The Storm Fused learned to cultivate their Inner Storm as they strain for enlightenment.

items.name: Pathogenic Genes
items.desc: A novel genetic disease prevents this species from producing offspring. It has resisted all known gene therapy methods.

items.name: Reawakened
items.desc: Extracted from Cetana's storage Matrix, these individuals have been reborn in synthetic forms. Their adjustment to this new existence is fraught with challenges. Their outward compliance masks a more profound struggle, as vacant expressions reveal the indelible scars left by Cetana's manipulations.

items.name: Egg Laying
items.desc: The young of this species do not develop inside a parent, but inside the protective shell of an egg. This allows for rapid growth during times of plenty.

items.name: Seasonal Dormancy
items.desc: This species has evolved on a planet with cyclical seasons that support hibernation. In the modern age, these seasonal triggers can be artificially simulated to efficiently store less productive members of society.

items.name: Hollow Bones
items.desc: The fragile bones of this species allow them to move elegantly and with ease. However, they are also more susceptible to the gravitational effects of their world.

items.name: Rooted
items.desc: This species literally takes root in whichever environment they find themselves, making removal a highly traumatic experience.

items.name: Acidic Vascularity
items.desc: The internal fluids of this species serve as their most potent defense. Highly corrosive and lethal, these liquids ensure that any enemies regret poking holes.

items.name: Shelled
items.desc: Whether naturally grown or found by chance (or design), this species carries their homes with them. These shells provide a protective sanctuary, ensuring there is always a place to rest for the night.

items.name: Camouflage
items.desc: Masters of disguise, this species seamlessly merges with their surroundings, rendering themselves nearly invisible to predators and prey alike. Their innate understanding of optics gives them an edge in guerilla warfare.

items.name: Chromalogs
items.desc: Harnessing the artistry of color, this species has transcended mere camouflage, evolving to communicate through the vibrant and intricate patterns displayed on their bodies.

items.name: Brittle
items.desc: Plagued by inherent fragility, this species must exercise extreme caution in daily activities to avoid cracking up during even the most mundane tasks.

items.name: Familial
items.desc: Bound by deep, enduring relationships with their closest relatives, this species forms highly efficient and cohesive collectives.

items.name: Permeable Skin
items.desc: Specially developed skin that requires ideal conditions coats this species. As long as this species does not stray far from their home climate that shouldn't be a problem.

items.name: Genetic Memory
items.desc: Passing down knowledge and learnings from one generation to the next has been the start of many civilizations. This species has taken it a step further by encoding survival insights directly into their genetic code, ensuring that each generation is born with the accumulated wisdom of their ancestors.

items.name: Nascent Stage
items.desc: This species gives birth at an early stage of development, resulting in a prolonged period where the young are incapable of contributing to society. During this time, they remain blissfully unaware of the responsibilities and burdens that come with sapience.

items.name: Flight
items.desc: This species soars above the constraints of the earth, freely navigating the skies. Their cities feature unique, dense layouts, optimized for aerial inhabitants. In conflict, they prove to be elusive and difficult targets.

items.name: Spatial Mastery
items.desc: Not only capable of flight, this species possesses unique cerebral adaptations, enabling them to instinctively process and navigate three-dimensional spaces. These abilities make them unparalleled in planning battles, surveying planets, and managing cities.

items.name: Spare Organs
items.desc: This species evolved redundant organs to survive even the most grievous injuries - a successful adaptation, as evidenced by their continued existence.

items.name: Malleable Genes
items.desc: §LThis species does not stick as rigidly to identifiable features and organs as most other species do. Instead they grow the best appendage for the job. However this instability has some drawbacks.§!

items.name: Malleable Claws
items.desc: §LWith diamond-hard digits, this adaptation allows for easier extraction of minerals.§!

items.name: Malleable Insulators
items.desc: §LA thick insulating layer safeguards against accidents, especially in high-energy environments.§!

items.name: Malleable Plows
items.desc: §LAn extra appendage with a hardened shovel-like digit speeds up tilling and planting. Adapting to various terrain types, these malleable plows are always the right tool for the job.§!

items.name: Malleable Cortex
items.desc: §LWhile an engorged central cortex is slightly uncomfortable, it dramatically accelerates problem-solving and innovation.§!

items.name: Malleable Sense Organs
items.desc: §LEnhanced sensory organs facilitate a deeper understanding and appreciation of diverse perspectives. Before you can thrive, you must first observe.§!

items.name: Malleable Calluses
items.desc: §LWhen handling scalding or corrosive materials, extra-thick calluses can be invaluable.§!

items.name: Malleable Pheromones
items.desc: §LHighly adaptive pheromones can be incredibly persuasive during negotiations.§!

items.name: Malleable Harmonics
items.desc: §LA series of highly-calibrated holes allows this species to produce soothing, and harmonious sounds simply by moving about.§!

items.name: Adaptive Mutations
items.desc: §LBy introducing hyper-adaptive nucleotides into the genetic structure of this species, they are capable of evolutionary changes in real time.§!

items.name: Adaptive Claws
items.desc: §LWith diamond-hard digits, this adaptation allows for easier extraction of minerals.§!

items.name: Adaptive Insulators
items.desc: §LA thick insulating layer safeguards against accidents, especially in high-energy environments.§!

items.name: Adaptive Plows
items.desc: §LAn extra appendage with a hardened shovel-like digit speeds up tilling and planting. Adapting to various terrain types, these malleable plows are always the right tool for the job.§!

items.name: Adaptive Cortex
items.desc: §LWhile an engorged central cortex is slightly uncomfortable, it dramatically accelerates problem-solving and innovation.§!

items.name: Adaptive Sense Organs
items.desc: §LEnhanced sensory organs facilitate a deeper understanding and appreciation of diverse perspectives. Before you can thrive, you must first observe.§!

items.name: Adaptive Calluses
items.desc: §LWhen handling scalding or corrosive materials, extra-thick calluses can be invaluable.§!

items.name: Adaptive Pheromones
items.desc: §LHighly adaptive pheromones can be incredibly persuasive during negotiations.§!

items.name: Adaptive Harmonics
items.desc: §LA series of highly-calibrated holes allows this species to produce soothing, and harmonious sounds simply by moving about.§!

items.name: Wilderness
items.desc: §LThis species exists as part of a mutualistic entity, made indistiguishable from its environment in its thoughts and productive output.§!

items.name: Slimespawn
items.desc: This species spawns rapidly from a thick and mucilaginous slime with the aid of a gestational catalyst.

items.name: Inner Darkness
items.desc: Their bodies enhanced following saturation in Dark Matter, they now vent trace amounts of non-baryonic particles at regular intervals but will burn through their expected lifespan more quickly.

items.name: Geleboric Mutations
items.desc: Unfortunate reactions to experimentation drastically altered this species' physiology.

items.name: Psionic Ephapse
items.desc: After long-term exposure to mind-altering bacteria, this species' digestive system produces psionic probiotics that promote telepathic communication between affected individuals.

items.name: Cyber Commandos
items.desc: Total limb replacements and bonded nanomesh body armor ensure these cyborgs can wage war with brutal efficiency. As a consequence, several non-military bodily functions have been sacrificed.

items.name: Cyber Shock Troops
items.desc: These cyborgs benefit from a holistic approach to embodied loadouts. Rather than fully-integrated body armor, swappable augments allow for a modicum of non-military function.

items.name: Cyborg Soldiers
items.desc: Elegant augmentations to these cyborgs' senses, glands, and motor nerves ensure they remain fierce and capable warriors while only marginally impacting their reproductive capabilities.

items.name: Unplugged
items.desc: Several of these cyborgs' augments were designed to utilize a battlefield network which no longer exists, causing intense stress and discomfort.

items.name: Disconnected
items.desc: The ill-fitting nature of these cyborgs' imposed, military augments greatly reduces their quality of life and increases their bodies' demands during periods of rehabilitation.

items.name: Haunted
items.desc: Auditory hallucinations and other sensory echoes from their former machine consciousness still haunt these cyborgs, causing them to suffer severe bouts of depression and anxiety.

items.name: De-Cyberized
items.desc: These ex-cyborgs have disabled or cast off the augments which had once been forced upon them, reclaiming many of their species' organic, inherited attributes.

items.name: Neuro-Calmed
items.desc: These cyborgs have their Neuroxene levels downregulated, reducing impulsivity and aggression, driving individuals to de-prioritize personal gain in favor of societal norms.

items.name: Neuro-Savant
items.desc: These cyborgs have their Cognivex levels upregulated, enhancing synaptic plasticity, information retention, and problem-solving abilities.

items.name: Regen-Optimized
items.desc: These cyborgs have their Regenol-X levels upregulated, harmonizing biological and synthetic systems, allowing cybernetic implants to self-repair at the molecular level.

items.name: Thermophile
items.desc: This species evolved tissues of metallic alloys to grow and thrive on hot planets where traditional organics would cook. These alloyed cells are slower to degrade and are replaced infrequently, delaying the onset of age-related diseases. They also conduct cold temperatures, which can threaten their health in colder climates.

items.name: Unbreakable Resolve
items.desc: Bound by an intricate web of mirror neurons, these individuals possess an innate ability to synchronize their will. Duty is not a burden, but a shared purpose, and hardship is met with unwavering unity.

items.name: Shell Slag
items.desc: An intricate symbiosis with £sr_living_metal£ §YLiving Metal§! allows this species to grow not in the traditional sense, but through the accretion and self-assembly of bio-ferrous structures.

items.name: Assembly Slag
items.desc: An intricate integration of £sr_living_metal£ §YLiving Metal§! allows this machine species to expand not through conventional construction, but via the accretion and self-assembly of auto-ferrous frameworks.

items.name: Pyroclastic Channeling
items.desc: Shaped by the relentless fury of volcanic worlds, this species does not fear pyroclastic forces - they channel and manipulate them, transforming devastation into a vital source of sustenance and power.

items.name: Crucible Community
items.desc: Tempered by adversity and bound by shared struggle, this species has been forged into an unbreakable whole. Their collective will fuels governance, each member a vital link in the chain of unity.

items.name: Tankbound
items.desc: This species lives out its existence suspended in a vat of specialized bio-fluids. As such, they are heavily reliant on assistive equipment and incapable of engaging directly in physical work.

items.name: Uncanny Intuition
items.desc: This species exhibits an inexplicable ability to navigate through complex problems on its first attempt.

items.name: Cranial Hypertrophy
items.desc: The frame of this species' neural encasement has inflated to the point where its physical capabilities have become somewhat limited.

items.name: Cranial Megatrophy
items.desc: The frame of this species' neural encasement has inflated to its ultimate biological limit.

items.name: Haunting Visions
items.desc: Entities from other dimensions send maddening visions into the minds of this species, affecting their ability to perform complex tasks.

items.name: Blind
items.desc: Where we are going, we won't need eyes to see.

items.name: Marked
items.desc: In a gruesome display of devotion, this species has branded its flesh with the mark of 'The End'.

items.name: Photoadaptive
items.desc: This species resonates with starlight. Variations in stellar luminosity subtly reshape their biology as they journey between stars.

items.name: Solar Celled
items.desc: This species developed specialized solar cells to absorb different kinds of stellar radiation in unique ways, resulting in a variety of benefits adapted to each star type.

items.name: Recursive Learners
items.desc: Born to the Arkship, this species refines its knowledge in generational cycles, each cohort improving upon the last to meet their vessel's unique demands.

items.name: Structural Awareness
items.desc: Designed to live within the Arkship, these machines continuously map its internal stresses, flows, and routines. Different arkship designs produce different patterns, and they iteratively optimize their behavior to match the vessel they inhabit.

items.name: Interconnected
items.desc: Over generations, the boundary between Arkship and occupant has dissolved. The vessel became an extension of their senses and limbs; they, in turn, became a functional component of its design.

items.name: Reaver
items.desc: Cunning, not camaraderie, shaped this species' evolution. Every interaction is a contest of will, and survival belongs to the most ruthless.

items.name: Combat-Synced
items.desc: Each unit is both engineer and combatant. In wartime, their synchronized protocols stabilize the whole and keep critical systems repaired and optimized.

items.name: Terraphobic
items.desc: Having adapted to life aboard artificial environments, this species finds planetary environments oppressive. Gravity, atmosphere, and terrain pose constant challenges to their frail physiology.

items.name: Redundant Module
items.desc: The core design of these units includes inactive hardware of an unknown purpose, removal of which causes severe malfunctions. Its presence in the system results in some performance inefficiency.

items.name: Restored Module: Defense Systems
items.desc: Complex algorithms inherited from an archaic data center enable these machines to exceed normal performance limits in order to support a wide range of military functions.

items.name: Restored Module: Research Multicore
items.desc: A compound multithreading algorithm, uniquely adapted to these machines' hardware, facilitates exceptional performance in research and technical tasks.

items.name: Restored Module: Recursive AI
items.desc: These machines benefit from quantum self-improvement subroutines that process data gathered by all networked units, both functioning and historic. This allows for the dynamic refactoring of their codebase for improved performance.

items.name: Restored Module: Administration Matrix
items.desc: These machines are optimized for efficient infrastructural management, owing to protocols sourced from an archaic data center. Batched processing of administrative tasks enables units to operate and self-correct with reduced oversight.

items.name: Restored Module: Reactive Shielding
items.desc: Harsh and unfamiliar surroundings are no impediments to these machines, whose morphogenetic surface plating can be energized to allow for rapid reaction to environmental changes.
